Claim amendment · 2026-11-05T05:19Z · file surface widened before the first commit.

- Added: `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts` (the plugin constructs `LocalManifestSource` and rehydrates; the one-time adoption of the old cwd ledger runs there, before rehydrate) and `packages/cli/src/commands/doctor.ts` (it joins `cwd` + `DEFAULT_INSTALLED_PACKAGES_DIR` itself; once the default moves, doctor and the runtime would read two directories, so it must read the same resolver in this PR).
- Design (dev): default = `OS_HOME/installed-packages` when `OS_HOME` is set, else `cwd/.objectstack/installed-packages` as today; when the new directory is absent and the old cwd one has entries, copy once at boot (never delete the old files), one log line; `--fresh` tells the child through an internal channel to skip the adoption.
- `Clause-②`: the dev measures; a new export (`resolveInstalledPackagesDir`) would make it `yes (widening)`, recorded at PR time with the lane seat's `TIER_DEFAULT` review.
- Unchanged: `Metadata-protocol: none`, branch `claude/project-thread-14pct9`.
